name: Hurrikan
description: Hurrikan (Hurricane) is a German fishing card game closely related to the Italian classic 'Scopa' and its Spanish cousin 'Escoba'. Players capture cards from a central layout by matching values from their hand. The game is named for the 'Hurrikan' move (a 'Sweep'), where a player captures all cards from the table in a single turn.

content.text: Hurrikan (Hurricane) is a German fishing card game closely related to the Italian classic 'Scopa' and its Spanish cousin 'Escoba'. Players capture cards from a central layout by matching values from their hand. The game is named for the 'Hurrikan' move (a 'Sweep'), where a player captures all cards from the table in a single turn.
A regional adaptation of 'Scopa' that migrated to Germany. It preserves the core capturing mechanics but uses standard or German-suited cards and a specific point-target of 16.
Usually 32-40 cards. If using 52, remove 8s, 9s, 10s. Ranking: Ace (1), 2-7 (Face), Jack (8), Queen (9), King (10).
Deal 3 cards to each player and 4 face-up on the table.

items.text: Scopa: The Italian original with 40 cards.
Escoba: Spanish variant where you must sum to 15.
Cirulla: A highly complex Ligurian variant.
